note: The single-region runtime admits TiKV leader-only access and explicitly rejects follower, mixed, learner, stale, and proxy routes. TiFlash and the broader access-mode index remain external.
API-v1 lookup keys and TiKV current-region boundaries cross one explicit memcomparable encode/decode boundary. Keyspace-v2 codecs, scans, and split RPCs remain external.

Ordered lookup, exact observed-route validation, known-leader update, deferred no-leader invalidation, epoch-ahead retry, and atomic split/merge replacement execute through the sole RegionCache authority. Returned current regions are accepted as the available sibling subset, matching client-go without inventing full-coverage requirements. TTL, buckets, background refresh, production concurrency, and broad batch loading remain external.

The PD-declared leader is selected only when peer, store, address, and captured store epoch agree. Follower, mixed, learner, stale, prefer-leader, and proxy policies explicitly fail closed; their routing strategies, busy scoring, and retries remain external.
The bounded selector never consults slow scores because it admits only an exact leader route. Sliding windows, health scoring, and busy fallback remain external.

A sorted region vector preserves source key order, half-open containment, and the pre-delete stale-overlap guard that protects newer split children from stale parents. B-tree concurrency, TTL traversal, batch ascent, and benchmarks remain external.

Immutable store observations are exact-epoch checked; TiKV current-region peers are re-resolved through PD, witnesses are filtered, the responding store is preferred when usable, unknown roles survive, and any hydration failure leaves the old cache atomic. Liveness, health scoring, TLS probes, and background refresh remain external.
